docs.summary: Turns arbitrary text into something safe to use as a single path segment.
docs.remarks: Anywhere a name the user typed becomes a folder or a file. Dropping the invalid characters is not enough on its own: "." and ".." survive that filter and still walk up a directory, and a name that is rooted or carries a separator makes `Combine` return somewhere else entirely rather than a child of the folder that was meant.
